description: Land Acquisition - Udupila, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, and boundary information) in a particular village and district. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition matters, which is a primary land and property-related administrative function.
